Jobbeschreibung
Sales Consultant – Recruiting & Neukundengewinnung (m/w/d)
Du bist im Vertrieb zuhause – und merkst langsam, dass dir etwas fehlt. Vielleicht eine Provision, die nicht bei einem festgelegten Wert endet. Vielleicht ein Produkt, hinter dem du wirklich stehst. Oder einfach der Punkt, an dem der Kunde nach der Unterschrift an jemand anderen übergeben wird und du nie erfährst, ob dein Versprechen gehalten hat.
Bei uns läuft das anders: Du gewinnst den Kunden
und lieferst danach selbst ab. Du berätst Unternehmen zu ihren Recruiting-Problemen, verkaufst die Lösung – und setzt sie anschließend eigenverantwortlich um. Ein Ansprechpartner, ein Verantwortlicher, ein Ergebnis.
Wir sind eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, ihre Arbeitgebermarke sichtbar zu machen und planbar qualifizierte Mitarbeiter zu gewinnen – mit datenbasiertem Recruiting statt Bauchgefühl. Der Markt dafür wächst jedes Jahr weiter, weil Fachkräftemangel und demografischer Wandel nicht kleiner werden.
Was für dich drin ist
Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter Bonus – kein Deckel, keine gestaffelten Bremsen. Was du holst, bekommst du.
Unbefristete Festanstellung – wir bauen langfristig auf dich, in einer Branche, die stabil wächst.
Zweites Standbein: Recruiting-Know-how – du lernst nicht nur zu verkaufen, sondern auch zu liefern. Das Doppelprofil aus Vertrieb und Recruiting ist im Markt aktuell das gefragteste überhaupt. Entwicklungspfad: Sales Consultant → Senior Consultant.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & echtes Coaching – Schulungen in Beratung, Vertrieb und Recruiting, dazu regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions statt einmaliger Einarbeitung.
Arbeitsplatz ohne Kompromisse – höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Technik (MacBook Air/Pro, iMac), Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Premium-Fitnessvertrag im Studio deiner Wahl.
Versorgung im Office – Faema-E61-Siebträger mit Julius-Meinl-Kaffee, gute Tees und flexibles Lunch-System über Meyer Menü.
Kurze Wege – direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kollegiale und leistungsorientierte Atmosphäre. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einer Schublade.
Dein Tag bei uns
Du gewinnst die Projekte
Du sprichst potenzielle Neukunden aktiv an – telefonisch, per Video-Call und über Direktansprache – und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Du analysierst, woran das Recruiting im jeweiligen Unternehmen hakt, benennst den konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst daraus eine passende Strategie.
Du präsentierst deine Lösung und führst den Prozess bis zum Abschluss.
Du setzt sie um
Nach der Unterschrift steuerst du das Projekt eigenständig weiter – von der Kampagnenplanung bis zur besetzten Stelle.
Du koordinierst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst die Vorqualifizierung und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidaten einen professionellen Eindruck von deinem Kunden bekommen.
Dein Fundament
Du pflegst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielgerichtet auf deine KPIs hin.
Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen zur Prozessverbesserung ein.
Das solltest du mitbringen
Vertriebserfahrung – ob Telefonvertrieb, Außendienst, Einzelhandel, Fitness- oder Versicherungsbranche: Wenn du weißt, wie sich ein "Nein" anfühlt und wie man trotzdem weitermacht, passt das.
Beratungsverständnis – du erkennst Potenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst Lösungen strukturiert rüber.
Menschenkenntnis – du verstehst die Perspektive des Unternehmens genauso wie die des Bewerbers.
Eigeninitiative und Leistungswille – du arbeitest selbstständig und willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse, nicht durchschnittliche.
Recruiting-Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, kein Muss. Das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei. Uns interessiert weniger dein Lebenslauf als das, was du daraus machen willst.
So geht es weiter
Bewerben in 2 Minuten – ohne Anschreiben, dein Lebenslauf reicht.
Kurzes Kennenlern-Telefonat – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.
Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Office in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Nimm deinen Erfolg JETZT selbst in die Hand – wir freuen uns auf dich!

About Omtera
Omtera is an AI deployment and enterprise technology company helping leading organisations across EMEA turn world-class technology into real, production-ready business solutions.

We design and deliver AI deployment, customer engagement, product analytics and work-management projects using technologies from companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, FinAI, Braze, Snowflake, Asana, Mixpanel, OneSignal and some others.

Our teams work with globally recognised organisations including NEXT, Qatar Airways, ELM Company, Mobily, Intel and Delivery Hero , supporting complex enterprise projects from initial discovery and commercial design through implementation, adoption and expansion.

We are now looking for a commercially ambitious Sales Executive to help grow our AI and SaaS solutions business across EMEA. Tasks This is a broad, consultative sales role covering both subscription-based SaaS solutions and AI deployment projects.

You will identify potential customers, understand their business challenges, develop opportunities and work alongside Omtera ’s technical consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers to create solutions that customers can confidently buy and deploy.

Depending on your experience, you may join us as an early-career Sales Executive ready to develop quickly, or as a more experienced Account Executive capable of owning opportunities independently. This is not a scripted sales role.

You will need to understand technology, ask intelligent questions and connect customer challenges with the right commercial and technical solutions.

Approximately 50% of your working day will require fluent English , both written and spoken, including customer meetings, internal collaboration, proposals, presentations and communication with international technology partners. What You Will Do
Build and manage a pipeline of AI deployment, SaaS subscription and professional services opportunities across EMEA.
Identify and engage relevant decision-makers through outbound prospecting, networking, events, partner referrals and inbound opportunities.
Conduct discovery meetings to understand customer objectives, technical environments and commercial priorities.
Position solutions involving OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, FinAI, Braze, OneSignal, Asana, Mixpanel and other leading technology platforms.
Work closely with solution consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers to shape proposals, demonstrations, pilots and deployment plans.
Manage the sales process from initial contact through qualification, proposal, negotiation and closing.
Develop clear commercial proposals covering subscriptions, implementation services and ongoing support.
Maintain accurate opportunity, activity and forecast information in the CRM.
Build long-term relationships with customers and identify renewal, expansion and cross-sell opportunities.
Collaborate with international partner and vendor sales teams on joint opportunities and go-to-market initiatives.
Continuously improve your understanding of AI, SaaS, enterprise technology and the industries we serve.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal ’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

s.h: In the first week, expect to
s.t:
Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal ’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

s.h: In the first month, expect to
s.t:
Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
Work with the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) General Manager to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
Shadow key calls and client meetings.
Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing industry network and relationships, to articulate Toptal ’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations.
Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.

Begin shaping industry solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including AI-enabled approaches, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly working to innovate alongside your clients.
Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their priorities and current initiatives.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

s.h: WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA
s.t:
We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture.

With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

Generate qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound lead follow-up, account-based engagement and creative prospecting strategies.

Qualify opportunities and work closely with Account Executives to ensure high-quality handovers.
Collaborate with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Sales Leadership to improve pipeline generation and conversion.
Use modern sales technology, AI-powered tools and data-driven insights to work effectively and continuously improve performance.

The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world.

Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

s.h: THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD
s.t:

Motivation personnelle et ambition d’évoluer dans le poste ; expérience en vente technique / services analytiques / organismes de recherche sous contrat (une expérience dans les sciences de la vie / l’industrie pharmaceutique est un atout).

s.h: About us - Malvern Panalytical , Micromeritics and SciAps.
s.t:
Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.
We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.
Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.
Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. Our leading technologies measure surface area, porosity, density, adsorption and particle activity.
SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.
We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are more than 2,500 employees in a customer-focused organization with sales and service offices in 20 countries, all committed to delivering expert and responsive customer support.
We are part of Spectris. Spectris combines precision with purpose, delivering progress for a more sustainable world. Precision is at the heart of what we do – our leading, high-tech instruments and software equip our customers to solve some of their greatest challenges to make the world cleaner, healthier and more productive.
Malvern Panalytical , Micromeritics & SciAps
Your Partners in Discovery
Malvern Panalytical , Micromeritics and SciAps, part of the Spectris Group, are committed to a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can thrive and achieve a fulfilling career.

Changing the world isn’t something you can do on your own, or with a single way of thinking; it takes a wide collection of experiences, stories, knowledge, and expertise. We encourage applications from underrepresented individuals and people with diverse backgrounds.

Although we always select the most qualified applicant for each role and make all decisions without regard to race, sex, age, or any other protected class, we are an inclusive, equal opportunity organization that prizes diversity. Your unique perspective is important to us.

About the Client
Our client is a global medical technology company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China. It is a pioneer in diabetes management and care, focused on developing and delivering innovative, user-friendly medical devices and solutions that help people living with diabetes lead healthier and more independent lives.
Their comprehensive portfolio includes advanced products such as patch insulin pump systems, continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems, blood glucose monitoring tools, and point-of-care diagnostic devices. These solutions support both patients and healthcare providers in managing blood glucose levels more effectively and making better therapeutic decisions.
The company operates internationally, serving markets across Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and China, with a commitment to innovation, quality, and improving daily life for people affected by diabetes.

**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
* A passion for helping organisations prepare for and respond to cyber threats
* Practical experience in one or more areas such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, or Cyber Defence
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions
* Understanding of modern threat actors, attack techniques, and cyber defence best practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Curiosity, drive, and a desire to continuously learn and develop

* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Cyber Defence Centre (CDC), CSIRT, or Incident Response team
* Exposure to AI-enabled security operations, security automation, detection engineering, or threat validation
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent
* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. One day you may be helping a client define their future Cyber Defence Centre strategy, the next designing security monitoring capabilities, improving incident response processes, or supporting the implementation of leading security technologies.
We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.
Ready to make an impact?
Join us and help organisations build the capabilities they need to detect threats faster, respond smarter, and emerge stronger from cyber incidents. Your next challenge starts here.

About the Hiring Manager
Hey, I'm Bishop, Head of Customer Experience at Wonderly .
I started in FP&A, realized I wanted to be in the middle of building something instead of analyzing it from the outside, and ended up here.
I'm hiring early-career operators who can sell. People I can put on the phone with a business owner and trust to open the relationship, run the conversation, and move the deal forward. The role I'm hiring for is the role I would have killed for at 22.

You own the top of our funnel. You'll run outbound to service business owners — cold calls, follow-ups, whatever it takes to get them on the phone — pitch the Wonderly model, qualify for fit, and hand the hot ones off (often live) to our team to close.
You're the first human a future customer talks to. The pipeline grows because you make it grow.
This is not a read-from-a-script seat. Our outbound motion is early, and you'll help build the playbook, not inherit a finished one. When something in the process is broken, you flag it and help fix it.
The work is hands-on and high-volume. You'll live on the phone, own your number, keep your pipeline and CRM tight, and feed what you're hearing back into how we target and message. You're not above the grind, and you're not just a dialer either — you think about how to make the whole motion better.
And it's not only calls. We have aggressive growth goals, and hitting them means the outbound engine has to scale — which means digging into your own data, spotting what's working and what isn't, and helping build the systems and process that let us do 10x the volume without falling apart.

You'll analyze your numbers, surface patterns, and help stand up the tooling and playbook that scale us. The best people here don't just hit their number, they help build the machine that makes everyone's number easier to hit.
If you want a defined script and a narrow lane, this isn't it. If you want to carry a number, build the outbound engine with us, and get dramatically better at selling fast, apply.
What Makes This Role Different
Most early-career sales roles are narrow. You join, you run someone else's script, you get good at one motion.
This is the opposite. You're getting in early on the outbound engine of a company that's scaling fast — which means outsized ownership, real influence on the playbook, and a front-row seat to how a company goes from early traction to serious scale. Top performers here move fast into senior sales, team lead, and ops roles.

Younergy Solar ist ein Unternehmen für erneuerbare Energien, das Photovoltaik\- und Energielösungen für Unternehmen, öffentliche Institutionen und Privatkunden in der ganzen Schweiz entwickelt und realisiert. Zur Verstärkung unseres Wachstums in der Deutschschweiz suchen wir eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Leistungsausweis im B2B\-Verkauf. \- Du vertrittst Younergy an Messen, Ausstellungen und Fachveranstaltungen in der Deutschschweiz

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Erfolgsausweis und Netzwerk, kein Berufseinstieg.

Remote (US) · ET or CT time zone · [$60,000 base / $90,000 OTE] + equity
The short version: NetFoundry , the company behind OpenZiti, the world’s most used open source Zero Trust networking software, is hiring two founding SDRs to build NetFoundry 's outbound engine. This is a hunter role selling Zero Trust connectivity into cybersecurity, cloud, and AI infrastructure teams. If you want to build the playbook instead of inheriting one and have ambition to become an AE, keep reading.

AI broke the network security model.
Agents, models, and APIs now need to reach data and systems scattered across clouds, data centers, edge sites, and customer environments. Every one of those connections is a new attack surface. VPNs, open inbound ports, and firewall rules were never designed for a world where the thing requesting access is a non-human identity that spun up four seconds ago.
NetFoundry replaces that model. Our Identity-First Connectivity™ platform delivers Zero Trust connectivity with no VPNs, no open inbound ports, and no firewall changes enabling enterprises to connect AI agents, APIs, and distributed workloads without exposing anything to the internet.
Enterprises use us to secure access to their APIs and agentic AI services, to run microsegmentation, and to simplify hybrid IT/OT segmentation. Software and IoT providers use us to reach workloads inside their customers' networks.
We were founded by the inventors and maintainers of OpenZiti, the world's most-used open source Zero Trust networking software. We're Series A, backed by SYN Ventures and Cisco Investments, headquartered in Charlotte, NC, and remote-first since day one.

We have one SDR today. We're hiring two more, and we're building the enterprise go-to-market motion around you.
That means the target account strategy, the sequences, the call openers, the objection handling, the way we mine our open source community for enterprise signal - isn't fully developed yet. You'll contribute to it working directly with our AEs, our marketing team, and GTM leadership that has built and exited multiple startups.
This is the right role if you want to be early. It's the wrong role if you want a machine that already runs.
